method.record_unit: one P2 JSONL object; every one of 833 records receives status, relation and reason
method.path_family_unit: project + relative_path; every one of 254 path families receives a role, snapshot variants and target package
method.content_identity: P2 raw-byte SHA-256; exact duplicates require equal SHA-256 and same raw content, not only similar headings
method.heading_comparison: P2 first/top-level heading metadata plus deterministic heading digest when bytes were available on readback
method.link_comparison: deterministic normalized link-set digest/count/class comparison; remote bodies read with read-only GitHub API at named refs; no push/fetch/pull
method.logical_duplicate_screen: normalized token cosine/Jaccard screen used only as a review signal; boilerplate/run identifiers are not collapsed; final relation is documented per group
method.lifecycle_rule: P2 freshness is age/provenance metadata, not lifecycle authority. HISTORY/STALE means superseded or dated content; EVIDENCE means an immutable run/report/source; CANONICAL/SOURCE follows P3.
method.local_drift_rule: When current bytes no longer match the P2 SHA-256, do not invent old headings/links; report the drift and use P2 metadata only for the unavailable old bytes.
method.safety: No source document was edited, moved, deleted, merged, installed, published or pushed by P4.

status_vocabulary.CANONICAL: bieżące źródło normatywne wg P3; nie przenosić bez decyzji
status_vocabulary.EVIDENCE: dowód przebiegu, testu, dispatchu albo readbacku; zachować proweniencję
status_vocabulary.STALE: treść nadrzędna została zastąpiona albo zawiera historyczny stan; nie używać jako normy
status_vocabulary.LOCAL_ONLY: proweniencja obecna wyłącznie lokalnie; zwykle secondary status
status_vocabulary.REMOTE_ONLY: proweniencja wyłącznie na nazwanym remote; w tym P4: 0
status_vocabulary.DUPLICATE: identyczny snapshot względem preferowanego recordu tej ścieżki
status_vocabulary.CONSOLIDATION_CANDIDATE: unikalny materiał do macierzy pokrycia P5/P6; bez automatycznego merge
status_vocabulary.OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED: nie przenosić ani nie zmieniać bez decyzji właściciela i readbacku

logical_relations.relation: semantic overlap in entry/current-state routing, not exact duplicate
logical_relations.signal: CLAUDE.md, NAGENTS-PROJECT.md, old indexes and handoffs share start/read/next-state vocabulary
logical_relations.reason: Only CLAUDE.md and docs/process/handoff.md are current normative entry/format sources per P3; other indexes are dated snapshots or candidates.
logical_relations.decision: P5 chooses one lightweight index; P4 keeps every source.

logical_relations.relation: logical duplicate/coverage overlap between current spec and legacy plans
logical_relations.signal: highest nAgents text-overlap examples: PLAN-WDROZENIA ↔ SPECYFIKACJA 0.690; RAPORT ↔ SPECYFIKACJA 0.647
logical_relations.reason: Legacy files contain unique rationale and older scope; they cannot replace the current docs/spec package.
logical_relations.decision: P6 builds section-level coverage before any extraction; no deletion in P4.

logical_relations.relation: question/answer snapshots overlap decisions and ECHO
logical_relations.signal: old question sets repeat decision vocabulary and include variants; current decisions/ECHO add later literal entries
logical_relations.reason: A similar paragraph is not a new owner decision. Current decisions and literal ECHO win; history remains evidence.
logical_relations.decision: Reconcile question IDs/statuses before copying; do not ask or decide again from an archive.

logical_relations.relation: layered process docs and dispatch reports share workflow terms
logical_relations.signal: skill, universal skeleton, dispatches and employee guide intentionally reuse process vocabulary
logical_relations.reason: The project skill is normative, universal skeleton is reference, employee guide is audience-specific, dispatches are evidence. Similarity is not permission to merge layers.
logical_relations.decision: Keep the layers and map sections into NAGENTS-PROCESS.md/NAGENTS-USER-GUIDE.md in P6.

logical_relations.relation: research synthesis overlaps captured primary sources
logical_relations.signal: nota 06/07 summarize appto source captures; Microsoft source snapshots have high link density and dated headings
logical_relations.reason: Synthesis, primary source and owner decision have different evidentiary roles.
logical_relations.decision: Preserve source hashes/links and cite only dated, verified claims in NAGENTS-RESEARCH.md.

logical_relations.relation: Hermes/Entra/Microsoft 365 integration documents overlap but do not select a mechanism
logical_relations.signal: nota 09/10, M365 handoffs and older research describe adjacent paths
logical_relations.reason: P3 explicitly leaves the integration choice to the owner; protocol description is not runtime proof.
logical_relations.decision: No consolidation or access broadening until owner decision plus live readback/test.

logical_relations.relation: contract/runbooks/relay documents share routing and lifecycle terms
logical_relations.signal: ABM contract says one profile/board; runbooks and relay snapshots detail implementation/readback
logical_relations.reason: AUTOBOT-KANBAN is the canonical contract; ops docs are supporting and relay content is local-only/current-candidate.
logical_relations.decision: Use a precedence table in AUTOBOT-PROJECT.md; do not let a static runbook override live readback.

logical_relations.relation: package README, lifecycle docs and reports describe overlapping deliverables
logical_relations.signal: local package README adds 44 lines and a new r4 heading over remote baseline; reports map acceptance criteria
logical_relations.reason: Package source, installation policy and historical acceptance evidence must stay separately auditable.
logical_relations.decision: Release review reconciles hashes and manifest; no publication or install in P4.

logical_relations.relation: semantic template repetition across distinct run IDs, not duplicates
logical_relations.signal: ABM-V2-H-001 evaluator dispatch snapshots reach cosine similarity 0.935 while IDs/stages/parents differ
logical_relations.reason: Run IDs, role, round and evidence paths give each record independent audit meaning.
logical_relations.decision: Never collapse across run IDs; deduplicate only exact same SHA-256 copies of the same path.
